data.name: Aref
data.gender_notes: Aref is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Aref means 'knowledgeable', 'learned', or 'wise'. This name carries a deep spiritual significance, as knowledge and wisdom are fundamental aspects of faith and personal growth in Islam. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) is known as the 'most knowledgeable among the people' (Aref Al-Anam), and seeking knowledge is a fundamental pillar of the Islamic faith. The name Aref is a reminder of the importance of continuous learning and striving for wisdom and knowledge.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of the pursuit of knowledge and wisdom in Islam.
data.etymology: Aref belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Knowledgeable, learned, wise.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aref total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: عارف
in_arabic.meaning: العارف: من يعرف الله ويتعرف عليه باليقين
in_arabic.long_meaning: العارف هو من يعرف الله تعالى باليقين، ويتعرف عليه بالعيان، ويكون له معرفة خاصة بالله تعالى، كما ورد في القرآن الكريم: وَمَا أَكْثَرُ النَّاسِ وَلَوْ حَرِصْتَ بِمُؤْمِنٍ . إنما يخشى اللهَ من عبادِهِ العلماءُ (فاطر: 28) والعلماء هم العارفُونَ بالله

in_english.name: Aref
